violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR prep top cooler: sliced deli provolone (47f), portioned chicken (46f), shredded mozzarella (49f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 1DR prep top cooler was observed at 54f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DO NOT USE THIS COOLER TO STORE TCS FOOD. REPAIR OR REPLACE BEFORE USING.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: Observed the drainage pipe of the 3-compartment sink’s WASH BASIN and the PREP SINK hanging below the floor rim of the floor drains.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CUT PIPES TO ALLOW FOR AN AIR GAP TO PREVENT SEWAGE BACK FLOW. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) broken door gasket of the 1DR prep top; 2) 1DR flat top cooler was observed at 47f
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPLACE GOOD GASKET BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. SERVICE THE 1DR FLAT TOP COOLER. COOLERS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32-38f.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: Observed cardboard boxes of unused canned corn covered in chicken marinade splatter.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CLEAN FOOD SPLATTER AFTER TYING RAW CHICKENS ON SKEWERS

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) aluminum foil was observed lining the bottom shelf of the prep tables.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. REMOVE FOIL AND REPLACE WITH MATERIAL THAT IS SMOOTH, DURABLE, AND EASILY CLEANABLE (ie: ACRYLIC, PLEXIGLASS). ALTERNATIVELY, REPLACE ALL PREP TABLES AND OPT FOR STAINLESS STEEL INSTEAD OF GALVANIZED STEEL.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The gasket on the 1DR prep top cooler was observed in poor repair. The handle of the rice warmer was observed broken.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPLACE GASKET AND REPAIR HANDLE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed a pressure washer connected directly to the mop sink with no backflow prevention device.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE OPTIONS. INSTALL A BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE MOP SINK OR DISCONNECT THE PRESSURE WASHER HOSE AFTER EVERY USE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed PIC wash hands in the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WASH HANDS AT THE HAND WASHING SINK. EVERY SINK HAS A PURPOSE. THE HAND WASHING SINK IS FOR HANDWASHING. THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK IS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING DISHES. THE PREP SINK IS FOR FOOD PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink next to the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap at the hand sink next to the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PLACED SOAP AT THIS HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: During the inspection, chlorine was observed being used for sanitization. Chlorine test strips were not observed in the facility. EHS observed pH test strips. Upon discussion with PIC, quaternary ammonia is regularly used for sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: PLEASE PURCHASE CHLORINE TEST STRIPS FOR CHLORINE SANITIZATION. PLEASE PURCHASE QUATERNARY AMMONIA TEST STRIPS FOR QUATERNARY AMMONIA SANITIZATION.
